decision: Drop InstanceNorm from the discriminator and broadcast conditioning words into its first conv (early fusion); keep late concat.
evidence: probe_noise_vs_word_sensitivity: noise-only delta rose 0.0069->0.0268, word-only delta 0.0083->0.4209; InstanceNorm was erasing the brightness statistics D needs, leaving it at chance.
alternatives: more training, extra loss terms, bigger G
status: superseded by the research/measure path; GAN frozen

decision: Produce images by measuring researched photographs into committed VisualFacts and rendering them deterministically; no diffusion, no montage, no per-subject code.
evidence: ../grounded is the theory (does not work); measure.rs + scene.rs render plate-0000 within its measured bbox [64,18,133,224].
alternatives: keep training the GAN; hosted diffusion backend

decision: Split the mask into connected components and cluster pieces that share columns (overlap in x) as one subject; record every other region beside the figure without claiming it.
evidence: Hals plate: Commons documents a coat-of-arms to the left; components are torso [64,18,133,99], skirt [64,187,97,224], coat-of-arms [35,167,51,200] recorded-beside and excluded.
alternatives: largest single blob (measured only the head)

decision: Measure silhouette width as horizontal extent; for a bucket the plate showed nothing in (black silk dress on dark ground), carry width between measured neighbours and paint the plate's own color there, flagging it in profile_covered.
evidence: plate-0000 dress band y102-166 is indistinguishable from surround (color distance RMS ~6, Otsu-pass 3.6%); profile_covered marks 9 carried buckets.
alternatives: density profile (collapsed the middle); interpolate an invented width/colour

decision: Refuse a cluster that runs off the frame as a scene, not a bounded subject.
evidence: 35-plate bank: 6 bounded subjects (0,2,6,16,24,25), 28 refused as scenes, 1 no separable subject; isolatable figures and the Barye sculpture pass, subjects inside scenes do not.
alternatives: accept whole-frame region as subject (rendered a meaningless slab); accept-but-flag

decision: A refusal is never terminal: it states what to clarify and invites another run rather than stopping.
evidence: the image and coding loops share one rule — no dead ends, clarify with the user then repeat with the clarification.

decision: Segment against the plate's own ground noise in color-opponent space (L, R-G, (R+G)/2-B), significance Z_FAR=6 sigma on border-ring MAD, refusing one-edge-away feet-cropped figures are still subjects; replace the Otsu luminance cut whose 18.55 threshold split the dark dress in two.
evidence: plate-0000 skirt is indistinguishable from ground in luminance (RMS ~6) but warm (R-G 14..30 vs 3..5); render's penis-like spike was an unmeasured mid-dress bucket interpolated as a constant 20px rod; per-band silhouette now reads head 31 -> shoulders 85 -> waist 70-103 -> dress 120-135 -> feet 68, measured render byte-deterministic.
alternatives: Otsu on luminance (missed the dress interior, synthetic spike); brightness floor (invented)

decision: A bounded figure is a subject only when it is substantial: >=5% of the plate and spanning half the frame in height or width; otherwise refuse as 'not substantial: clarify which region is the subject' rather than claim a patch.
evidence: 35-plate bank re-run: tiny bright-patch slivers (plates 1,20,23,31) and a forest path top-right patch (30) previously claimed as subjects; gate keeps 7 committed (0,2,12,16,24,30,33), all >=9.5% of their plate, and plates 6/25, previously OK under discarded Otsu, now honestly refuse (nothing 6-sigma away from their own texture).
alternatives: accept any 1%+ region (claimed path-patches); area-only floor (lost thin seated woman)

decision: A clarification answer feeds back into measurement as a region: measure_with_region(img, meta, [x0,y0,x1,y1]) re-derives the ground from the box's own perimeter and hard-windows the far-mask to the box. Quantified on the 35-plate bank: whole-frame refused full-frame stock photos (plates 3,4) as scenes; pointed boxes recover a measured subject (plate 3 box 60,40,150,255 -> bbox [60,40,150,254], 14.8%, method region:60,40,150,255, byte-deterministic). Color proximity hints were tried and rejected on the real bank: plates 6/25 sit 97% of pixels within 6-sigma of every tested color.
evidence: whole-frame plat 3 = 'scene, clarify which region'; probe (probe_region.rs) region-local separation; plate 6/25 near-mask 96.9-98.1% across all hint colors
alternatives: color hint (proximity, could not separate any real plate); accept whole-frame scene as subject

decision: The refusal is a durable record, never a dead end: measure records 'which region is the subject' and prose requests record their aspects to data/clarifications.jsonl (date, kind, plate/request, aspect, question, answer, resolved), and the new 'gc clarify [--answer aspect=value] [--store FILE]' command senses and retires unknowns; answers are facts that license the next action (--hint re-measures the answered plate).
evidence: gc clarify 'Write a program that macros a keystroke.' opens 5 aspects (language/platform/interface/which_keystroke/macro_meaning); answering language/which_keystroke/macro_meaning retires them; measure of plate 3 refused then committed with --hint
alternatives: silent exit; answer only in the head

decision: gc measure --bank DIR (no --index) sweeps every plate in one pass: committed plates write plate-NNNN.json into --out-dir, refusals upsert one question per plate into --clarify-out, and a plate that later measures plainly heals its own stale open question (slug 'measured without an answer'). gc clarify --replay FILE --bank DIR --out-dir DIR reads the journal, marks measure records resolved by answer (precise `N:subject-region=x0,y0,x1,y1` wins over general `subject-region=`), re-measures the answered plates, and writes the journal back.
evidence: 35-plate sweep: 7 committed, 28 open questions; replay with one answer (plate 3) resolves and re-measures plate-0003.json, 27 remain open
alternatives: per-plate shell loop (refusals died in stdout); answers only in the head

decision: The coding loop closes the same way measure does: gc chat --clarify-answers 'aspect=value' (repeatable) runs clarify::resolve first; a code request given any answer owes every aspect — open aspects print and the run exits 2 (never plan on half-answers). Fully resolved, the answer fields fold as facts into the StructuredIntent the planner reads (language and platform land on their existing fields, everything else becomes a 'aspect: value' constraint), and --clarify-store records the resolved prose round to the question journal like gc clarify does.
basis: AGENTS loop (failure is a question; answers license the next action)
evidence: 5-flag demo for 'Write a program that macros a keystroke.': 1 flag refuses at exit 2 naming the 4 open aspects; full answer prints 'facts folded: language=Rust, platform=Linux' then proceeds; --clarify-store writes a resolved:true code record with all answers; case-insensitive 'rust' check keeps the crates.io dep gate even for the offered capitalized 'Rust' option.
alternatives: conversation-only answers (forgotten); silently overwriting intent fields with any strings (invention)

decision: The full 35-plate bank is swept with the release binary into the repo itself, once, and the journal replayed with every known answer: data/visual holds plate-NNNN.json for exactly the 7 committed plates (0,2,3,12,16,24,30,33) — byte-identical to the reference sweep (deterministic) — and data/clarifications.jsonl holds the durable brain state: 28 open measure questions + the plate-3 question now resolved with its region answer. Replay is proven idempotent: a second run acts on 0 questions and rewrites the journal and facts byte-for-byte.
basis: AGENTS loop: research (bank) → measure (sweep facts) → commit (data/) → act (replay answers)
evidence: release sweep in 19s: 7 committed / 28 refused, facts identical to prior sweep; replay resolves plate 3 and writes plate-0003.json matching the committed plate-3-attractive-woman.json; second replay: '0 questions acted on', md5 of journal+facts unchanged
alternatives: keep memory in /tmp scratch (lost); commit ambiguous answers (invention)

decision: The open questions are the agenda, but only measurement licenses a new commit. The whole-frame discovery probe (probe_subject: same pipeline as measure — border/dominant ground, morph, components, cluster_columns) reports each refused plate's candidate figure bbox; region answers are chosen as a box around the discovered figure and applied through replay. Plate 4 (young woman standing straight, 158x256) committed with the tightest box (58,8,96,235) reproducing its figure bbox [59,9,95,234], 12.4% area, hfrac 0.88 — one connected component. Plates 8, 9, 1, 20, 23, 31 refused under every region tried: their figures are genuinely small/corner/crowd subjects, and 5/7/10 read as zero separable pixels whole-frame — the substantiality floor and no-subject gate both hold under region attention. The bank grows 7→8 committed; 27 questions stay open.
basis: measure-with-region semantics: committed frac/hfrac stay against the whole plate, so a box cannot fake substantiality
evidence: probe_subject plate 0004 → figure bbox [59,9,95,234]; 6 candidate boxes all commit at the same figure; 9 region boxes across plates 8/9/1/20/23/31 refuse; plate-0004.json: single component, method region:58,8,96,235, area_frac 0.124, height_frac 0.883
alternatives: clock a box around any blob and claim it (invention — the gate and titles contradict it); answer plates by title guesswork
